item.Q: A 12 V supply drives a 4 Ω resistor. What current flows, and what power does the resistor dissipate?
item.A: I = V/R = 3 A, and P = V·I = 36 W.

item.Q: Two 100 Ω resistors in parallel have a total resistance of {{c1::50 Ω}}.
Why is the resistance of resistors in parallel always less than the smallest of them?
item.A: Each one adds another path for the current: conductances add, so the total conductance is larger than any single one.
